The main takeaway from our work is that
aging is not a homogenous process and that there are likely multiple mechanisms that contribute to memory deficits in aged mice.
the expression of Glu1 NMDA subunit splice variants is not uniform across the lifespan, and that the expression of these variants may be related to age and behavioral performance.
